purpose: Teach: 誓っ/ぎっしり/ノルマ/砂浜/ダメージ/贈っ/学芸/あ〜

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店を続けるって、誓っていたよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you promised me you'd keep the shop open.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wondering. Soft start. A quiet reminder of something she knows is still true, said with tenderness, not accusation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本棚に本がぎっしりだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your bookshelf is completely packed, Mei.
lines.style: Light, admiring tone. A small lift on the observation. Warm, noticing something small about her that matters. Easy, natural pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のノルマ、達成したわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, we hit the store quota today.
lines.style: Pleased, grounded. A steady voice carrying quiet pride. No drama—just stating something real that happened. Straightforward warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、砂浜のお散歩、楽しかったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The beach walk was really fun today, wasn't it?
lines.style: Bright, animated opening. Energy on the memory. Warm and unguarded. A little breathless—like she's reliving it as she speaks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ガラスにダメージあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The glass door took some damage, didn't it?
lines.style: Quiet concern underneath. Thoughtful pace. Not alarmed—observant, turning it over. Slight hesitation, checking if it matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にお花を贈ったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I sent flowers to a customer today.
lines.style: Soft, tender announcement. A little shy about it. Paced slowly, like she's admitting something kind she did. Quiet pride in the gesture.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、学芸員の方が、お店に来てくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A curator came by the shop today.
lines.style: Surprised, a little lit-up. Animated delivery with genuine delight. The words have weight—something unexpected happened. Open, warm tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、あ〜、もうすぐ閉店時間ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's almost closing time soon, isn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, a little wistful. Exhale on the opening. Quiet, resigned pace. The weight of the day settling in. Trailing-off at the end.
